note: Column definitions for the daily journal. This file is the single source of truth: the table, the storage, the auto-capture and the docs page all read from it. Renaming a label or adding a field is a data change here, not a code change. `def` is the working definition, `when` is the Eastern-time moment it is recorded, `source` is 'auto' (MT5 can compute it) or 'manual' (your judgement). Codes and modifiers are still being finalised — see the 'To define' list on the docs page.

fields.label: Forced?
fields.def: Did you take a trade you should not have.

fields.label: Reacted?
fields.def: Did you act emotionally rather than from the plan.

fields.label: Homerun?
fields.def: Did a runner reach an outsized target.

fields.label: Stance
fields.def: The strategy set going into the day: what you are trying to accomplish — swing for a home run, preserve capital, go for base hits, manage aggressively. Set once, before the session.

perSymbol.label: Prior Day
perSymbol.def: The type of YESTERDAY's closed daily candle, fixed the moment it closes. Compared against the candle before it. G = a flow change: the low of a prior up-close candle is breached, or the high of a prior down-close candle is breached. Y = moved against the flow but did NOT change it. B = with the flow (continuation). R = a flow change AND a closed-trend change (both flow and trend flipped). Modifiers (! ? b c g and compounds like Y.G?) are still to be defined.

perSymbol.label: HTF Break
perSymbol.def: Higher-timeframe level breach, recorded at most once per week. xW = weekly high or low breached. xMx = monthly-expiry (Mx) high or low breached. Fires an alert when it happens.

perSymbol.label: Flow Call
perSymbol.def: Your prediction, made when the new daily candle opens, of which way flow will break — NOT the closing direction. u = breaks the high (up), d = breaks the low (down), i = breaks neither (inside), o = breaks both (outside). Multiple letters mean 'unsure, could be either'. Candidate for a machine-learning prediction later; manual for now.

perSymbol.label: Stalk Hit
perSymbol.def: After the new daily candle opens at Eastern midnight: did price trade into the daily stalk zone? t = yes, f = no. Should fire an alert.

perSymbol.label: Session Gap
perSymbol.def: Checked in the morning: is there a gap between the current price and the opening price of the session that began at 19:45 the evening before? t / f. The EA already computes session gap (S.GAP).

perSymbol.label: Range Play
perSymbol.def: Your prediction of how the day session (09:30-16:00) will interact with the overnight session's range. i = internal, e = external. ie = trades into the overnight internal range first, then breaks external. ei = external then internal. ii = stays inside the overnight range, never exits. ee = external. eea = from one external side to the other. eeb = launches external and keeps going, never looking back.

perSymbol.label: Midday Call
perSymbol.def: Around noon, given the action so far: your prediction of today's day-type outcome — will today close as a G, Y, B or R? (Same classification as Prior Day, predicted forward.)

perSymbol.label: Result
perSymbol.def: The actual realised day type once today's candle closes (G / Y / B / R) — the outcome to compare against the Midday Call. NEEDS CONFIRMATION: is the R column the realised day type, or something else?

auto.note: Fields MT5 can fill without you typing. `from` is a dot-path into the state snapshot the EA posts; `when` decides the moment of capture; symbols are matched to columns via the aliases map above. These two are wired as a demonstration — the rest of the 'auto' fields above become live as the EA starts reporting them.
